verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents the settlement mechanics well (charge-token API, committed/guaranteed pay-token amounts, 24h grace + up to 51h settlement window, wallet balance introspection with available/held/pending fields), which supports basic reconciliation of individual token charges. However, there is no documented payout/withdrawal-to-fiat flow, transaction export/statement/report API, or invoicing mechanism that a merchant would use to reconcile settlements against a bank ledger like a traditional payment channel. Missing for 10: documented payout/withdrawal to real-world currency, transaction history/export/reporting endpoints for accounting reconciliation, and any statement/invoice generation.
